description: Run an idempotent maintenance pass on a workspace namespace to deduplicate redundant records, link superseded state, and promote recurring high-salience episodic memories to Semantic tier (consumes 1 Write API call; non-destructive to unique facts) and return { namespace, consolidated }. Requires Write permission and a logical namespace (never prefixed with "org:"). Use at session wrap-up after multiple encode_memory calls; use feedback instead to rate one memory, or delete_by_context to purge obsolete tags.

namespace.description: Logical workspace namespace to consolidate (for example "my-project").

name: consolidate
title: Consolidate Namespace Memories
